summary: Casey's General Stores filed a Form 8-K reporting routine Items 2.02 (Q4 and FY2026 earnings release), 5.02 (annual incentive plan payouts at 161% of target and FY2027 long-term equity grants to NEOs with 25% RSUs, 75% PSUs subject to ROIC/EBITDA goals with TSR modifier), 5.03 (unstated), and 8.01 (unstated). The filing does not disclose any M&A, activist, strategic review, tender, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management departure. It solely describes ordinary-course compensation arrangements and earnings results. No special-situation event is present.
